svg.title: One thousand people as one thousand squares
svg.desc: A grid of one thousand squares coloured by whether the condition was there and what the test said.
svg.text: The same thousand people, one square each
Squares are laid out in reading order: the 9 true positives first, then the 99 false
alarms, then the single missed case, then everyone the test correctly cleared.
The outline holds the 108 people who tested positive.
Only 9 of the 108 squares inside the outline are dark blue.
More than nine in every ten positives are false alarms.
